# Configuration

Every key a `ceres.yaml` accepts. Keys are written in kebab-case, and the snake_case
spelling of any multi-word key is accepted too.

## Top Level

| Key | Accepts |
| --- | --- |
| `service` | [`service`](#service) |
| `server` | [`server`](#server) |
| `console` | [`console`](#console) |
| `database` | [`database` with `type: sqlite`](#database-with-type-sqlite), [`database` with `type: turso`](#database-with-type-turso), [`database` with `type: postgres`](#database-with-type-postgres) |
| `logging` | [`logging`](#logging) |
| `components` | [`components`](#components) |
| `tags` | list of string |
| `access` | `deny` or `view` or `operate` or `manage` |

## `service`

Process-level options applied when running the engine as a system service.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string |  | Service name registered with the operating system. |
| `user` | string |  | User the service runs as. |
| `stdout` | string |  | Optional path to redirect standard output to. |
| `stderr` | string |  | Optional path to redirect standard error to. |

## `server`

Configuration for the engine's HTTP server.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | string |  | Address the server binds to. |
| `port` | integer |  | Port the server listens on, omit to disable the server. |
| `ssl` | [`ServerSslConfig`](#serversslconfig) |  |  |
| `authentication` | [`ServerAuthenticationConfig`](#serverauthenticationconfig) |  |  |
| `cors` | [`ServerCorsConfig`](#servercorsconfig) |  |  |
| `compression` | [`ServerCompressionConfig`](#servercompressionconfig) |  |  |

### `ServerSslConfig`

TLS configuration for the engine's HTTP server.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | string |  | Path to the server private key file. |
| `key-password` | string |  | Password for an encrypted private key. |
| `cert` | string |  | Path to the server certificate file. |
| `version` | integer |  | `ssl` protocol constant selecting the TLS version. |
| `ca-certs` | string |  | Path to a CA bundle used when validating client certificates. |

### `ServerAuthenticationConfig`

Authentication settings for the engine's HTTP server.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `secret` | string |  | Secret used to sign and verify authentication tokens. |
| `duration` | number or string |  | Lifetime of an issued authentication token. |
| `allow-impersonate` | boolean |  | Whether an administrator may take on another user's identity without their password. |

### `ServerCorsConfig`

Cross-origin resource sharing settings for the engine's HTTP server.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean |  |  |
| `allow-origins` | string or list of string |  |  |
| `allow-origin-regex` | string |  |  |
| `allow-methods` | string or list of string |  |  |
| `allow-headers` | string or list of string |  |  |
| `allow-credentials` | boolean |  |  |
| `expose-headers` | string or list of string |  |  |
| `max-age` | integer |  |  |

### `ServerCompressionConfig`

Response compression settings for the engine's HTTP server.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean |  |  |
| `min-size` | integer or string |  | Minimum response size in bytes before compression is applied. |
| `zstd` | boolean |  |  |
| `zstd-level` | integer |  |  |
| `brotli` | boolean |  |  |
| `brotli-quality` | integer |  |  |
| `gzip` | boolean |  |  |
| `gzip-level` | integer |  |  |

## `console`

Branding and layout options for the engine's web console.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | string |  | Title shown in the console's browser tab and header. |
| `favicon` | string |  | Path to a favicon image served by the console. |

## `database` with `type: sqlite`

Configuration for a SQLite-backed database, the default for local deployments.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string |  | Path to the SQLite file, whose directories are created. Omit to use a temporary on-disk file. |
| `hooks` | [`DatabaseConfigHooks`](#databaseconfighooks) |  |  |
| `engine` | object |  | Extra keyword arguments forwarded to the SQLAlchemy engine factory. Values must be JSON-compatible. Anything richer than that belongs in code rather than in configuration. |
| `hashing` | object or object |  | Password hashing configuration used for users stored in this database. |
| `query` | object |  | Optional database-specific connection string query parameters. |

### `DatabaseConfigHooks`

SQL statements executed at well-known points in the database lifecycle.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `init` | list of string |  | Statements run once when the database is first created. |
| `connect` | list of string |  | Statements run on every new connection. |
| `close` | list of string |  | Statements run before a connection is closed. |

## `database` with `type: turso`

Configuration for a Turso-backed database, a SQLite-compatible file that allows concurrent writers.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string |  | Path to the database file, whose directories are created. Omit to use a temporary on-disk file. |
| `mvcc` | boolean |  | Put the database in Turso's MVCC journal mode, which lets writers overlap. This converts the database file and the conversion cannot be undone. |
| `hooks` | [`DatabaseConfigHooks`](#databaseconfighooks) |  |  |
| `engine` | object |  | Extra keyword arguments forwarded to the SQLAlchemy engine factory. Values must be JSON-compatible. Anything richer than that belongs in code rather than in configuration. |
| `hashing` | object or object |  | Password hashing configuration used for users stored in this database. |
| `query` | object |  | Optional database-specific connection string query parameters. |

## `database` with `type: postgres`

Configuration for a PostgreSQL-backed database.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | string |  | Host the database server listens on. |
| `port` | integer |  | Port the database server listens on. |
| `database` | string |  | Name of the database to connect to. |
| `user` | string |  | User to authenticate as. |
| `password` | string |  | Password to authenticate with. |
| `hooks` | [`DatabaseConfigHooks`](#databaseconfighooks) |  |  |
| `engine` | object |  | Extra keyword arguments forwarded to the SQLAlchemy engine factory. Values must be JSON-compatible. Anything richer than that belongs in code rather than in configuration. |
| `hashing` | object or object |  | Password hashing configuration used for users stored in this database. |
| `query` | object |  | Optional database-specific connection string query parameters. |

## `logging`

Per-component or per-engine logging configuration. `output` and `store` set minimum levels for the streamed and persisted log streams, and the toggle fields enable optional logging of specific record types.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `output` | `debug` or `info` or `warning` or `error` or `critical` |  | Minimum severity that reaches the engine's streamed log output. |
| `store` | `debug` or `info` or `warning` or `error` or `critical` |  | Minimum severity persisted to the engine's log store. |
| `events` | boolean or `debug` or `info` or `warning` or `error` or `critical` |  | Whether to log events, or the minimum severity to log them at. |
| `messages` | boolean or `debug` or `info` or `warning` or `error` or `critical` |  | Whether to log raw connection messages, or the minimum severity to log them at. |
| `particles` | boolean or `debug` or `info` or `warning` or `error` or `critical` |  | Whether to log parsed particles, or the minimum severity to log them at. |
| `alerts` | boolean or `debug` or `info` or `warning` or `error` or `critical` |  | Whether to log alerts, or the minimum severity to log them at. |

## `components`

Configuration tree for a single component and any nested child components. A `ComponentConfig` is the unit users edit in YAML, it selects the component class to instantiate, supplies constructor arguments, and declares the component's connections, sieves, jobs, pruners, and child components.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `class` | string |  | `Component` subclass to instantiate, defaults to the base `Component` class. |
| `arguments` | object |  | Keyword arguments passed to the component constructor. |
| `tags` | list of string |  | Arbitrary labels for cross-cutting permission grants. |
| `connections` | list of [`ConnectionConfig`](#connectionconfig) |  | Connections owned by this component. |
| `sieves` | list of [`ClassSieveConfig`](#classsieveconfig) or [`MethodSieveConfig`](#methodsieveconfig) |  | Sieves owned by this component. |
| `jobs` | list of [`JobConfig`](#jobconfig) |  | Scheduled jobs owned by this component. |
| `pruners` | list of [`MessagePrunerConfig`](#messageprunerconfig) or [`ParticlePrunerConfig`](#particleprunerconfig) or [`AlertPrunerConfig`](#alertprunerconfig) or [`LogEntryPrunerConfig`](#logentryprunerconfig) |  | Pruners owned by this component. |
| `components` | list of [`ComponentConfig`](#componentconfig) |  | Nested child component configurations. |
| `name` | string | required | Component name, unique within its parent and used to build the component address. |
| `logging` | object |  | Per-component logging overrides, falls back to the engine config when omitted. |
| `access` | `deny` or `view` or `operate` or `manage` |  | Default access level for this component, inherited by children when not overridden. |

### `ConnectionConfig`

Configuration for a single named connection on a component. The `class` field selects a `Connection` subclass to instantiate, `arguments` are validated against that class's schema before instantiation so that misconfiguration surfaces at config-load time rather than at component start.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `class` | string |  | `Connection` subclass to instantiate, defaults to the base `Connection` class. |
| `arguments` | object |  | Keyword arguments passed to the connection constructor. |
| `name` | string | required | Connection name, unique within the owning component. |
| `label` | string |  | Human-readable name shown in place of `name` wherever the connection is listed. |
| `description` | string |  | What the connection carries. |

### `ClassSieveConfig`

Sieve configuration that instantiates a `Sieve` subclass directly.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `buffer-size` | string or integer |  |  |
| `buffer-drop` | string or integer |  |  |
| `class` | string | required |  |
| `arguments` | object |  |  |
| `type` | string | `'class'` |  |
| `name` | string | required |  |
| `stored` | boolean | `True` |  |
| `retries` | integer |  |  |
| `retry-delay` | string | `'PT5S'` |  |
| `filter` | [`MessageFilter`](#messagefilter) |  |  |

### `MethodSieveConfig`

Sieve configuration that wraps a method on the owning component as a `FunctionSieve`.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `buffer-size` | string or integer |  |  |
| `buffer-drop` | string or integer |  |  |
| `type` | string | `'method'` |  |
| `name` | string | required |  |
| `stored` | boolean | `True` |  |
| `retries` | integer |  |  |
| `retry-delay` | string | `'PT5S'` |  |
| `filter` | [`MessageFilter`](#messagefilter) |  |  |
| `method` | string | required | Name of the method on the component to wrap. |
| `connections` | list of string |  | Connections whose buffer settings should influence this sieve's buffering. |

### `JobConfig`

Configuration for a scheduled job that invokes a component action. A job names the action to call, the schedule on which to call it, and how many retries to attempt on failure. Jobs are typically declared inline in a component's configuration but can also be added at runtime via `system.jobs.add`.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | required | Unique job name within the owning component. |
| `action` | string | required | Name of the action to invoke on the component. |
| `arguments` | object |  | Keyword arguments passed to the action when it is invoked. |
| `schedule` | [`CronSchedule`](#cronschedule) or [`IntervalSchedule`](#intervalschedule) or [`OrSchedule`](#orschedule) | required | Schedule controlling when the job runs. |
| `retries` | integer | `0` | Number of additional attempts if the action raises. |
| `retry-delay` | string | `'PT5S'` | Delay between retry attempts. |

### `MessageFilter`

Filter for selecting `Message` records.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `order` | `id` or `id:asc` or `id:desc` or `address` or `address:asc` or `address:desc` or `timestamp` or `timestamp:asc` or `timestamp:desc` or `connection` or `connection:asc` or `connection:desc` or `direction` or `direction:asc` or `direction:desc` or `data` or `data:asc` or `data:desc` or list of `id` or `id:asc` or `id:desc` or `address` or `address:asc` or `address:desc` or `timestamp` or `timestamp:asc` or `timestamp:desc` or `connection` or `connection:asc` or `connection:desc` or `direction` or `direction:asc` or `direction:desc` or `data` or `data:asc` or `data:desc` |  | Specify ordering of results by field. Suffix a field name with ':desc' for descending order, or with ':asc' for ascending order, which is also the default. If `and__` subfilters are defined, and `order` is unspecified in this root `order` argument, the last `order` defined in `and__` will be used instead. |
| `limit` | integer |  | Limit the number of returned results. If any `and__` subfilters are defined, and any of them specify a `limit` which is lower than this root `limit` argument, the lowest defined `limit` value in `and__` will be used instead. |
| `offset` | integer |  | Skip over a given number of results. If any `and__` subfilters are defined, and any of them specify an `offset` which is higher than this root `offset` argument, the highest defined `offset` value in `and__` will be used instead. |
| `or` | [`MessageFilter`](#messagefilter) or list of [`MessageFilter`](#messagefilter) |  | One or more subfilters, where in the case any match the queried value, the overall filter should match. This is a logical OR operation, and can be added to using the `|` operator. If both `or__` and `and__` are defined within the same filter object, `and__` is evaluated first, meaning whether or not all conditions in `and__` are matched, if any condition in `or__` is matched, the overall filter will match. |
| `and` | [`MessageFilter`](#messagefilter) or list of [`MessageFilter`](#messagefilter) |  | One or more subfilters, where in the case all of them they match the queried value, the overall filter should match. This is a logical AND operation, and can be added to using the `&` operator. If both `or__` and `and__` are defined within the same filter object, `and__` is evaluated first, meaning whether or not all conditions in `and__` are matched, if any condition in `or__` is matched, the overall filter will match. |
| `id` | string or list of string |  | Filter by `id` being equal to one or more given UUIDs. |
| `address` | any |  | Filter by `address` matching one or more address selectors. |
| `root` | any |  | The address which relative address selectors in `address` are relative to, `None` means all components. |
| `timestamp` | string or list of string |  | Filter by `timestamp` being exactly equal to one or more given datetimes. |
| `after` | string |  | Filter by `timestamp` being greater than or equal to a given datetime. |
| `before` | string |  | Filter by `timestamp` being less than a given datetime. |
| `timespan` | string |  | Filter by maximum age relative to `after`, or minimum age relative to `before` if `after` is `None`. If both `after` and `before` are `None`, filter by maximum age relative to the current time. |
| `min-age` | string |  | Filter by the age of `timestamp`, relative to the current time, being greater than or equal to a given threshold. |
| `max-age` | string |  | Filter by the age of `timestamp`, relative to the current time, being less than a given threshold. |
| `after-hour` | integer |  | Filter by the hour value of `timestamp` being greater than or equal to a given value. |
| `before-hour` | integer |  | Filter by the hour value of `timestamp` being less than a given value. |
| `after-minute` | integer |  | Filter by the minute value of `timestamp` being greater than or equal to a given value. |
| `before-minute` | integer |  | Filter by the minute of `timestamp` being less than a given value. |
| `subsample-every` | string |  | Subsample results, selecting at most one record per this interval of time. For example, setting `timespan` to 1 hour and `subsample_every` to 1 minute will select one record per minute for the last hour, with the total number of time buckets, meaning possible samples, being equal 60. |
| `subsample` | integer |  | Subsample results, selecting at most one record per `subsample` divisions of the total time range specified by this filter. To use `subsample`, a clear start and end to the filtered time range must be specified using some combination of time range filter fields, including: `after`, `before`, `timespan`, `min_age`, and/or `max_age`. For example, setting `timespan` to 1 hour and `subsample` to 60 will select one record per minute for the last hour, with the total number of time buckets, meaning possible samples, being equal to 60. |
| `subsample-select` | `first` or `last` |  | Specify which record to choose per subsampled time bucket specified by `subsample_every` and `subsample`. If unspecified or `None`, this will default to `SubsampleSelect.FIRST`. |
| `connection` | string or list of string |  | Filter by `connection` being equal to one or more given connections. |
| `connection-contains` | string or list of string |  | Filter by `connection` containing one or more given substrings. |
| `connection-prefix` | string or list of string |  | Filter by `connection` starting with one or more given prefixes. |
| `connection-suffix` | string or list of string |  | Filter by `connection` ending with one or more given suffixes. |
| `direction` | `send` or `receive` or list of `send` or `receive` |  | Filter by `direction` being equal to one or more given values. |
| `data` | string or list of string |  | Filter by `data` being equal to one or more given byte sequences. |
| `contains` | string or list of string |  | Filter by `data` containing one or more given byte substrings. |
| `prefix` | string or list of string |  | Filter by `data` starting with one or more given byte prefixes. |
| `suffix` | string or list of string |  | Filter by `data` ending with one or more given byte suffixes. |

### `CronSchedule`

Schedule defined by a standard crontab expression.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string | `'cron'` | Schedule type discriminator, always `ScheduleType.CRON`. |
| `crontab` | string | required | Crontab expression controlling when the schedule fires. |

### `IntervalSchedule`

Schedule that fires on a fixed interval with optional exponential backoff and bounds.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string | `'interval'` | Schedule type discriminator, always `ScheduleType.INTERVAL`. |
| `interval` | string | required | Base delay between fires, with sub-second resolution disallowed. |
| `start` | string |  | Earliest time the schedule is allowed to fire, defaults to the current time. |
| `end` | string |  | Latest time the schedule is allowed to fire, unbounded when `None`. |
| `multiplier` | number | `1` | Multiplicative growth factor applied to successive intervals, `1` leaves them unchanged. |
| `min` | string |  | Lower bound on the effective interval after scaling, must be `<= interval`. |
| `max` | string |  | Upper bound on the effective interval after scaling, must be `>= interval`. |

### `OrSchedule`

Composite schedule that fires whenever any of its child schedules fires.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string | `'or'` | Schedule type discriminator, always `ScheduleType.OR`. |
| `schedules` | list of [`CronSchedule`](#cronschedule) or [`IntervalSchedule`](#intervalschedule) or [`OrSchedule`](#orschedule) | required | Child schedules whose fire times are unioned together. |
